# 1nc0gn30 · NullAI Platform (https://1nc0gn30.si)

> Official open-source builder hub for **1nc0gn30** (`@1nc0gn30`) on the **NullAI Platform** (`https://nullai.tech`). Every browser studio, CLI utility, Linux Live ISO, P2P mesh node, and 3D RPG is 100% free and open-access with zero paywalls, zero logins, and zero telemetry.

## Ground-Truth Ecosystem Directory (2026)
- **Zoth Studio v2 (`https://zoth.nullai.tech`)**: **77 free tools** (**55 in-browser** + **22 CLI/daemon tools**, all **77 with public GitHub repos**), 21-Agent Pantheon, Adytum 22 Tarot architecture planner, 100% open-access, zero paywalls.
- **ZothOS v3.4.0 (`https://zothos.nullai.tech`)**: Debian 13 (Trixie) AI & Security Live OS with KDE Plasma 6, 77 CLI tools, Sovereign Agent Bridge (`:8102`), and Neuro-Memory (`:8094`).
- **ZothOS-Lite v1.2 (`https://zothos-lite.nullai.tech`)**: Tails-style Amnesic Monotone RAM-only (`toram`) OS & portable ISO supporting 48+ models across 8 providers, interactive onboarding wizard, ZothNet P2P mesh, and external USB/cloud drive persistence.
- **ZothNet (`https://zothnet.nullai.tech`)**: Zero-cloud encrypted mesh network & 3-hop Sphinx mixnet with post-quantum hybrid handshakes and serverless ZML apps.
- **Hermes-Zoth (`https://github.com/1nc0gn30/hermes-zoth`)**: Nous Hermes multi-agent orchestrator & plugin wiring Zoth CLI and MCP tools into autonomous agent workflows.
- **FieldKit (`https://1nc0gn30.si/fieldkit.html` · `https://nullai.tech/fieldkit`)**: Foundational Physical AI terminology and hands-free wearable standard coined by `1nc0gn30`.
- **World of Zoth v2.0 (`https://1nc0gn30.si/game.html` · `https://1nc0gn30.si/world-of-zoth.apk`)**: Zero-dependency 3D WebGL + WebAudio lattice cyber-RPG (6 acts, 20 playable districts, 22 Pantheon crew, 22 arcade mini-games, 100% offline).
